steps.name: Fixture ready
steps.goal: Dismiss any Apple Account Verification with Not Now.
steps.done: The labelled native audio fixture is ready.

steps.name: Live words before stop
steps.goal: Tap Stream test clip and wait for live words. Do not finish or discard yet.
steps.done: The real native engine returns words while recording remains active.

steps.name: Cancel stream
steps.done: Cancellation clears the live transcript without sending it.

steps.name: Fresh stream
steps.goal: Tap Stream test clip again. Wait until the live words include Americans.
steps.done: A new stream works after cancellation.

steps.name: Finalize stream
steps.done: Stopping flushes the real native engine and shows the final transcript.
